plain_text:
Hear how a classically trained African American double bassist could only play
for a US symphony by joining the army and moving to Germany in the wake of
WWII. In season 2 of Getty’s Webby Award-winning podcast, actor Anna Deavere
Smith brings artists’ letters to life as Taylor, art historians, and contemporary
artists unpack the words and lives of Patterson, Marcel Duchamp, Frida Kahlo,
M. C. Richards, Nam June Paik, and Meret Oppenheim. Tune in at getty.edu
/recordingartists.
